title: Sylvan
summary: SYLVAN. [See Silvan.] SYL'VAN, noun A fabled deity of the wood; a satyr; a faun; sometimes perhaps, a rustic. Her private orchards, wall'd on ev'ry side, To lawless sylvans all access deni'd.
